newsitem.title: USA: Igene sues Archer Daniels - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Igene sues Archer Daniels - WSJ.

text.p: Igene Biotechnology sued Archer Daniels Midland, alleging ADM stole secrets valued at $100 million regarding Igene's process for making a pigment to turn farm-raised salmon pink, the Wall Street Journal reported.
The paper said in its electronic edition that Igene named ADM, ADM manager Charles Abbas and a former Igene employee, Ali Nikmehr, in the suit, which was filed in a Maryland district court.
Igene claims Abbas wooed the secrets from Nikmehr, whom it fired two weeks ago, the paper said.
Igene said that ADM had initially attempted to collaborate with it in making the pigment, the paper also reported.
